analysis: Reviewed the docs/reference/configuration.md change (head line 313 only): a new row documents DARKBLOOM_TTFT_FUSED_CAUSAL_PREFILL (exact '0' disables, default on, read once per process, not forwarded to LaunchAgents). It is documentation of a performance toggle for full-attention prefill chunks (single fused .causal SDPA call vs 128-query blocks). It touches no authentication, attestation, key custody, encryption or coordinator-provider protocol. The toggle is an env var read in the local provider process; it does not widen the remote attack surface. The risk of an operator altering it is covered by the existing operator-vs-process boundary (TB-003, ADV-001), and it does not change the output-integrity assumptions in T-007. The remaining lines (7, 312-476) are unchanged context. Nothing in them alters the SSD prefix cache posture (T-041): TTL, HMAC lookup tags, salt scoping and KEK semantics are unchanged. The libs/mlx-swift-lm change is a submodule pointer bump from 0351444e to 1bee5728. The submodule contents were not supplied, so the actual code behind the fused causal prefill path (AttentionV1.swift) and any other changes in that range cannot be reviewed. Open question for integration: whether the new submodule revision changes prefix-cache KV layout or serialization, paged KV handling, or memory accounting. These would affect T-041, T-028 and the TB-007 inference engine boundary. Also unverified: that the fused-prefill path preserves numerics and cache-donation behavior. The submodule bump is a coverage limit, not evidence of safety, so deeper review of the submodule diff is advisable.
